title: Blue Archive | Kei
description:
[h1][b] A live2D web wallpaper for Blue Archive [/b][/h1]

BGM: Blue Archive OST Theme 339
(can choose Theme 341)

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Custom Features[/h1]

[list]
 [*][b]Scale[/b]
 [*][b]Model Resolution[/b] (2K, 4K, 8K)
 [*][b]Target FPS[/b]
 [*][b]Intro Animation[/b]
 [*][b]Dialog[/b]
 [*][b]Headpatting[/b]
 [*][b]Mouse Tracking[/b] (Eye Movement Following Cursor)
 [*][b]Fireworks Effect[/b] on Mouse Click
 [*][b]Background Music (BGM)[/b]
 [*][b]Voiceline Volume Control[/b]
 [/list]

Supports dialog text in [b]Japanese[/b], [b]English[/b], and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b].

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Implementation[/h1]

[list]
 [*]Uses [url=https://github.com/EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes]spine-webgl[/url] to render Spine models
 [*]Uses [url=https://github.com/nihui/realcugan-ncnn-vulkan]realcugan-ncnn-vulkan[/url] for 4x upscaling (8192×8192) of model textures
 [/list]
